rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE NAVAMSHA OF THE PLANETS THE SUN ETC IN THE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT OF UPANAYANA

planetary.freeform: Sun navamsha in lagna: cruel-minded; Moon navamsha: stupid; Mars navamsha: sinner; Mercury navamsha: clever; Jupiter navamsha: doer of shatakarma; Venus navamsha: doer of yagya and wealthy; Saturn navamsha: stupid.

rules.notes: Describes the personality or future traits of the child based on the planetary navamsha rising in the upanayana lagna.

rules.heading: THE SPECIALITY ABOUT THE NAVAMSHA OF THE MOON

planetary.freeform: Moon in auspicious navamsha: gets education; malefic navamsha: penurious; own navamsha: unhappy, but if in Shravana or Punarvasu and in own navamsha: wealthy.

rules.notes: Details the results of the Moon occupying various navamshas during the upanayana ceremony.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS OF THE PLANETS THE SUN ETC. WHEN THEY ARE POSITED IN THE ANGLES

planetary.freeform: Sun in angle: government service; Moon in angle: merchant; Mars in angle: arms trader or army job; Mercury in angle: teacher; Jupiter in angle: scholar; Venus in angle: wealthy; Saturn in angle: servant to low born.

rules.notes: Explains the vocational and life outcomes when specific planets are placed in angles during upanayana.
